key: A tab switcher and search panel for Chrome
zh: Chrome 的标签切换器和搜索面板

key: ⌃⇥ switches tabs in the order you used them. ⌘E finds tabs, bookmarks, history, folders and apps from one box.
zh: ⌃⇥ 按最近使用的顺序切标签。⌘E 在一个框里找标签、书签、历史记录、文件夹和 App。
Chrome 等 Chromium 浏览器 116+

key: Back to the last tab, not the next one
zh: 回到上一个标签，而不是旁边那个

key: Chrome's ⌃⇥ walks the tab strip. TabFlick makes it walk your history.
zh: Chrome 的 ⌃⇥ 按标签栏顺序走。TabFlick 让它按你用过的顺序走。

key: Tap again to go back. While held only a cursor moves, so tabs you pass are not counted as used.
zh: 再按一次就回到出发的标签；按住时只移动游标，中途经过的不算用过。

key: Recognise tabs by how they look, not by truncated titles.
zh: 靠页面样子认标签，不用读截断的标题。

key: ⌃⇧⇥ goes back, arrows move while held, or click a card.
zh: ⌃⇧⇥ 反向，按住时方向键移动，或直接点卡片。

key: Only the current window's tabs, each window with its own order. Can be turned off.
zh: 只列当前窗口的标签，每个窗口有自己的顺序。设置里可以关。

key: Type a few letters, get there
zh: 要找的东西，打几个字就到

key: Tabs, recently closed tabs, bookmarks, history, favorite folders and installed apps — one box.
zh: 标签、最近关闭、书签、历史记录、收藏的文件夹、已装的 App，都在同一个框里。

key: All, Tabs, Search, History, Bookmarks, Closed, Folders, Apps — you pick which ones and in what order.
zh: 全部、标签、搜索、历史记录、书签、最近关闭、文件夹、应用依次切，顺序和开关在设置里定。

key: Full pinyin and initials both match Chinese titles.
zh: 全拼和首字母都认，mnjt 能找到「蒙牛集团」。

key: With the browser's own engine, or site search like GitHub and YouTube.
zh: 用浏览器自己的默认引擎，也可以加 GitHub、YouTube 这类站内搜索。
在别的 App 里也能用。

key: Press ⌥Space to search every browser's tabs and jump straight there. With nothing typed it lists recent tabs and apps; Enter takes you back to what you were doing.
zh: 按 ⌥Space，搜所有浏览器的标签，选中就切过去。没输入时列的是最近用过的标签和 App，回车回到上一件事。

key: Folders: Enter opens, ⌘↩ picks an app
zh: 文件夹：回车打开，⌘↩ 换 App

key: Pinned tabs come back after a restart, on the last page you visited.
zh: 置顶的标签重启浏览器后自动回来，停在最后看的那页。

key: Close tabs unused for 12 h, 24 h or 7 days; pinned, audible and grouped tabs stay. Off by default.
zh: 12 小时、24 小时或 7 天没用过就关掉；置顶、在放声音的、标签组里的不动。默认关。

key: The menu bar lists every tab by window, plus recently closed ones; click to go there.
zh: 状态栏菜单按窗口列出所有标签和最近关闭的，点一下切过去。

key: Keep your usual folders in the menu bar and open them in Finder, a terminal or an editor.
zh: 把常用目录收在菜单栏，选 Finder、终端或编辑器打开。

key: Press ⌃⇥ outside the browser to see every browser's tabs, grouped. Off by default.
zh: 在浏览器之外按 ⌃⇥，按浏览器分组列出所有标签。默认关。

key: If the extension isn't connected, ⌃⇥ falls back to Chrome's own switching instead of doing nothing.
zh: 扩展没连上时，⌃⇥ 交回给 Chrome 自带的切换，不会按了没反应。

key: An app plus a browser extension. Two minutes.
zh: 一个 App 加一个浏览器扩展，两分钟装好。

key: Download the DMG and drag TabFlick into Applications. If macOS says the developer can't be verified, right-click TabFlick in Applications and choose Open.
zh: 下载 DMG，把 TabFlick 拖进「应用程序」。第一次打开如果提示无法验证开发者，在「应用程序」里右键 TabFlick 选「打开」。

key: Unzip the extension, open chrome://extensions, turn on Developer mode, click Load unpacked and pick the folder.
zh: 解压扩展包，打开 chrome://extensions，开启开发者模式，点「加载已解压的扩展程序」选中文件夹。

key: On first launch System Settings opens at Accessibility with TabFlick already in the list; turn it on and the app relaunches. A lit menu bar icon means it's connected.
zh: 第一次启动会打开「系统设置」的「辅助功能」页，TabFlick 已经在列表里，打开它的开关，App 会自动重启。菜单栏图标变亮就是连上了。

key: The extension asks for tabs, bookmarks, history, favicons and search; the data only goes to TabFlick on this Mac. After an update, allow any new permissions and reload the extension. Logs live at
zh: 扩展要标签、书签、历史记录、图标、搜索这几项权限，数据只交给本机的 TabFlick，不联网。升级后 Chrome 提示新权限时点允许，再重新加载扩展。日志在

key: Why an app plus an extension
zh: 为什么要一个 App 加一个扩展

key: The extension cannot read the keyboard.
Since Chrome 33 extensions can't bind shortcuts with Tab, so a native process handles ⌃⇥.
zh: Chrome 33 起扩展就不能绑定带 Tab 的快捷键，所以要一个原生进程接管 ⌃⇥。

key: The app cannot read the tabs.
Tabs, bookmarks, history and switching all go through Chrome's extension APIs, so an extension is needed. The two talk over a local WebSocket.
zh: 标签、书签、历史记录和切换都要走 Chrome 的扩展 API，所以要一个扩展。两边通过本机 WebSocket 连在一起。

key: All of them can be changed in Settings.

zh: 切到上一个用过的标签

key: Hold ⌃ and keep tapping to go further back
zh: 按住 ⌃ 连点，继续往回走

key: Move with arrows while ⌃ is held
zh: 按住 ⌃ 时用方向键移动
⌥Space 在任何 App 里都能用

key: Open from any app, across browsers
zh: 在别的 App 里打开，搜所有浏览器

key: Open a folder with another app
zh: 文件夹换一个 App 打开

key: TabFlick — tab switcher and search panel for Chrome
zh: TabFlick — Chrome 的标签切换器和搜索面板

key: The TabFlick Bridge extension isn't on the Chrome Web Store yet, so it installs via Developer mode — a one-time setup.
zh: TabFlick Bridge 扩展暂未上架 Chrome 应用商店，需要通过开发者模式安装，一次装好长期使用。

key: Download TabFlick-Extension.zip and double-click to unzip the TabFlick-Extension folder. Keep it somewhere permanent (e.g. Documents) — Chrome loads the extension from this folder, so deleting it disables the extension.
zh: 下载 TabFlick-Extension.zip，双击解压得到 TabFlick-Extension 文件夹。建议把它放到一个不会误删的位置（如「文稿」）—— Chrome 会持续从这个文件夹加载扩展，删掉文件夹扩展就失效了。

key: Type chrome://extensions in the address bar, or use Menu → Extensions → Manage Extensions.
zh: 在 Chrome 地址栏输入 chrome://extensions 回车，或菜单 → 扩展程序 → 管理扩展程序。

key: Flip the Developer mode toggle in the top-right corner; a new row of buttons appears.
zh: 页面右上角有「开发者模式」开关，打开它，页面顶部会多出一排按钮。

key: Click Load unpacked and select the TabFlick-Extension folder from step 1. When TabFlick Bridge appears in the list, you're done.
zh: 点「加载已解压的扩展程序」，选择第 1 步解压出的 TabFlick-Extension 文件夹。列表里出现 TabFlick Bridge 即安装成功。

key: With the TabFlick app running, the menu bar icon brightens and its menu lists your browser with a tab count. Hold ⌃ and tap ⇥ to bring up the switcher.
zh: 保持 TabFlick 运行，菜单栏图标变亮、菜单里列出浏览器和标签数，就是两端接通了。之后按住 ⌃ 点 ⇥ 就能唤出切换器。

key: Upgrading: when a TabFlick release notes an extension update, download the new zip, replace the folder's contents, then hit the refresh button (↻) on the TabFlick Bridge card in chrome://extensions.
zh: 升级说明：TabFlick 应用发新版时，如果发版说明提到扩展有更新，下载新的扩展包解压覆盖原文件夹，然后在 chrome://extensions 点击 TabFlick Bridge 卡片上的刷新按钮（↻）即可。
